instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium shot. Indoors against a solid dusty pink wall, the curly-haired woman in a white shirt (R1) stands in front, smiling at the camera with one hand in her jeans pocket. The straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) stands behind, hugging her with hands on her shoulders and smiling gently. Soft, diffused studio lighting creates a warm, minimalist atmosphere.
